title: João Pedro Campos
text:
I’m a PhD researcher at UFMG, affiliated with the University of Bristol, working at the intersection of probabilistic graphical models, Bayesian network inference, and explainable AI. Strong background in systems engineering, machine learning, deep learning, and optimization, including non-linear and linear programming. On the applied side, I build end-to-end machine learning systems.
My central research interest is making interpretable decisions with probabilistic models. .
